native25/supervisor.bash.contents:
printf 'ANCHOR:%s\n' "$BASHPID" >&9
IFS= read -r start <&8 || exit 98
[[ $start == START ]] || exit 98
printf 'STARTED:%s\n' "$BASHPID" >&9
exec 6<&0 5<&-
"$2" --noprofile --norc -c "$1" shell <&6 6<&- 8<&- 9>&- &
subject=$!
printf 'SUBJECT:%s\n' "$subject" >&9
exec 0<&- 6<&- 1>&- 2>&- 3<&- 4<&- 7>&-
wait "$subject"
status=$?
printf 'SUBJECT_EXIT:%s\n' "$status" >&9
IFS= read -r release <&8
[[ $release == release ]] || exit 99
exit "$status"

native3/supervisor.bash.contents:
printf 'ANCHOR:%s\n' "$BASHPID" >&9
IFS= read -r start <&8 || exit 98
[[ $start == START ]] || exit 98
printf 'STARTED:%s\n' "$BASHPID" >&9
exec 6<&0 5<&-
"$2" --noprofile --norc -c "$1" shell <&6 6<&- 8<&- 9>&- &
subject=$!
printf 'SUBJECT:%s\n' "$subject" >&9
exec 0<&- 6<&- 1>&- 2>&- 3<&- 4<&- 7>&-
wait "$subject"
status=$?
printf 'SUBJECT_EXIT:%s\n' "$status" >&9
IFS= read -r release <&8
[[ $release == release ]] || exit 99
exit "$status"
